title: Button group
summary: Buttons fused into one bar, horizontal, vertical or full width; with mode="single" its toggle buttons behave as one choice.

props.name: fill
props.description: Fills the container width and shares it between the buttons.

props.name: mode
props.description: single: the toggle buttons in the group release each other (one is always pressed); multi and none leave each toggle alone.

a11y: role=group with an aria-label. In single mode the pressed state lives in each button's aria-pressed and the group keeps exactly one pressed. Buttons keep their 44px phone height.

examples.title: Group and single choice
examples.html:
<pk-button-group label="View"><pk-button variant="ghost">Day</pk-button><pk-button variant="ghost">Week</pk-button><pk-button variant="ghost">Month</pk-button></pk-button-group>
<pk-button-group label="Density" mode="single"><pk-button toggle pressed variant="ghost">Compact</pk-button><pk-button toggle variant="ghost">Comfortable</pk-button></pk-button-group>
